svg.text: MFA / WebAuthn / Passkeys — Frontend LLD
TOTP (Authenticator App) Setup & Verification
Setup: server generates TOTP secret (base32, 160-bit) → QR code (otpauth:// URI)
QR encodes: issuer, account, secret, algorithm (SHA1), digits (6), period (30s)
Verify setup: user enters 6-digit code → server confirms before enabling MFA
Recovery codes: generate 10 × 16-char codes, bcrypt-hash server-side, show once
Login flow: password OK → challenge page → TOTP input → hotp(secret, floor(now/30))
Clock skew: accept T-1, T, T+1 windows (±30s tolerance) — prevent drift lockout
Replay: track last used counter server-side, reject reuse within same window
UI: numeric-only input, auto-submit on 6th digit, paste support, 30s countdown ring
WebAuthn / Passkeys — Registration & Authentication
Registration: server sends PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions (challenge, rp, user)
navigator.credentials.create({publicKey}) → authenticator generates key pair
Send to server: {id, rawId, attestation, clientDataJSON} → verify origin + challenge
Store: credentialId + publicKey + signCount (COSE-encoded, device-bound)
Authentication: server sends challenge → navigator.credentials.get({publicKey})
Verify: signature over clientDataJSON + authenticatorData using stored public key
signCount check: new > stored (detect cloned authenticator) → alert or block
Passkeys: synced via iCloud Keychain/Google Password Manager — cross-device login
MFA State Machine & UX Flows
States: unauthenticated → password_ok → mfa_challenge → authenticated
Step-up auth: resource requires higher assurance → re-challenge mid-session
Fallback chain: WebAuthn → TOTP → SMS OTP → recovery code (degraded)
Remember device: issue device token (httpOnly cookie, 30-day TTL) → skip MFA
Trusted device fingerprint: user-agent + IP subnet + stored device ID hash
MFA bypass detection: rate limit OTP attempts (5/10min), lock after 10 failures
Disable MFA flow: require current TOTP + password re-confirmation to disable
Admin bypass: super-admin can reset MFA; triggers audit log + user email alert
SMS OTP, Push & Edge Cases
SMS OTP: 6-digit, 10min TTL, bcrypt-hashed server-side, single-use, rate-limited
SIM swap risk: SMS is weakest — recommend TOTP/WebAuthn for sensitive accounts
Push notification MFA: mobile app receives push → user taps Approve/Deny
Push shows: location, device, timestamp — user can detect anomalous logins
WebAuthn browser support: Chrome 67+, Safari 14+, Firefox 60+ — feature detect
Conditional UI (passkeys): browser autofills passkey in username field (autocomplete=webauthn)
Attestation: none / self / packed — enterprise requires FIDO certification attestation
Account recovery: require ≥2 factors to recover (email link + recovery code + ID)
TOTP: HMAC-SHA1(secret, floor(unix/30)) mod 10^6
WebAuthn: device-bound key pair, phishing-proof
Passkeys: synced credentials — no password needed
Fallback: WebAuthn → TOTP → SMS → recovery code
Remember device: 30-day httpOnly cookie, fingerprint
